name: toolkit
description: Tool-specific CLI guidance for Apple container and Git workflows, including opt-in git-codex message-file lifecycle automation.

interface.shortDescription: Operate Apple container and bounded Git workflows.
interface.longDescription: Provides bounded skills for Apple container lifecycle and task-scoped Git commit, branch, push, recovery, and opt-in git-codex message-file lifecycle workflows.
defaultPrompt: Use $toolkit:apple-container for Apple container CLI tasks on Apple silicon macOS, including common commands, lifecycle checks, compatibility limits, installation, uninstallation, containerization concepts, and the bundled experimental k8s plugin without assuming third-party Kubernetes CLI execution.

Use $toolkit:git when the requested outcome includes a task-scoped Git commit with risk-proportional checks, message hygiene, one-related-change-unit granularity, a typed subject under 120 characters, and post-commit full-message verification; explicit git-codex installation or update; git-codex message-file create, validation, commit, and cleanup; branch creation; explicit git switch -C force-create; branch switching; upstream configuration; current-branch push; explicit refspec push; branch-prefix policy resolution; or recovery from a partial Git workflow.
